description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the API endpoints of the ClaimEventAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains multiple test methods with data providers, used to test creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting claim events via API calls.

classes.name: ClaimEventAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class executing API endpoint tests for ClaimEventAPI, covering create, get all, get one, update, and delete operations with data providers.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Test for creating a claim event via API using data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for testCreate method from YAML data.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Test for retrieving all claim events via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for testGetAll method.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Test for retrieving a single claim event via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for testGetOne method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Test for updating a claim event via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for testUpdate method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Test for deleting a claim event via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for testDelete method.
